claims.evidence: MaxQuant summary.txt groups the 9 runs into 6 experiments 1Asp,2Asp,3Asp,1Leu,2Leu,3Leu (one pooled 3-plex SILAC mixture each). Paper Methods: "Cell pellets from control and transfected cells from three independent experiments"; each mixture holds one mimic-transfected (heavy) and one scrambled-transfected (medium) culture. One source name per physical culture/lysate; the Leu original and -redo runs of the same MaxQuant experiment share source names because they are two acquisitions of the same pooled mixture.

claims.value: SILAC heavy (Arg10/Lys8) = Ld-tRF mimic; SILAC medium (Arg6/Lys4) = scrambled control oligonucleotide; SILAC light not annotated
claims.evidence: Paper Fig 1 legend: "The “Heavy” cell population was transfected with either Ld-tRF-Asp or Ld-tRF-Leu mimic, while the “Medium” cell population was transfected with either scrambled Ld-tRF-Asp or scrambled Ld-tRF-Leu (control)"; Fig 2A legend same for Asp. Methods: medium = "L-arginine-13C6, L-lysine 2H4 (Arg6, Lys4)", heavy = "(Lys8, Arg10)"; summary.txt Labels1 = Arg6;Lys4, Labels2 = Arg10;Lys8. Data check: S1 Table uses only Ratio.H/M.normalized columns; the paper fold changes equal the deposited H/M normalized ratios, e.g. Leu-up CD109 1.33 (deposited 1Leu/2Leu/3Leu 1.325/1.332/1.343, mean 1.333), Leu-down CPT1A 0.69 (0.680/0.706), ACSL4 0.77 (0.781/0.762); Asp-up 26S protease regulatory subunit 6B selective average 1.78 (2Asp 1.531, 3Asp 2.030). So the reported treated/control direction is H/M, consistent with heavy = mimic. No independent biological marker exists to orient the map further (a tRF mimic has no bait protein).

claims.value: transfection with synthetic Ld-tRF-Asp mimic (heavy) / transfection with scrambled Ld-tRF-Asp control oligonucleotide (medium)
claims.evidence: Methods: "synthetic RNA Ld-tRF-Asp, Ld-tRF-Leu oligos, and scrambled controls (Integrated DNA Technologies) were transfected into dTHP-1 cells (1 x 10^6 cells/60 mm plate/2 ml media) at 50 nM using HiPerfect reagent (Invitrogen) for 24 h for a SILAC-related proteomic study". Asp runs = MaxQuant experiments 1Asp-3Asp. Free text: no NCIT/EFO term for tRF-mimic transfection; control is a scrambled-oligo transfection, so "untreated" (rule 4) would be false.

claims.value: transfection with synthetic Ld-tRF-Leu mimic (heavy) / transfection with scrambled Ld-tRF-Leu control oligonucleotide (medium)
claims.evidence: Fig 1 legend: medium = "scrambled Ld-tRF-Leu (control)" for the Leu arm; Methods list a separate "tRF-Leu-scrambled" oligo sequence (AGGTTGCGATGGACGGTTGTG); S1 Fig: "mimics or corresponding scrambled oligos". Fig 2B legend instead says the Leu-arm medium population received "scrambled Ld-tRF-Asp (control)"; treated as a typo (2 sources vs 1), recorded in limitations.

claims.value: 1-3 within each treatment group = experiment number
claims.evidence: MaxQuant experiments 1/2/3 per arm; paper: "three independent experiments"; each mixture = one independently transfected culture per channel, so replicate n in the mimic group and n in the scrambled group are different cultures sharing an index (README.adoc:330, campaign rule 3).

summary.txt assigns each Leu original and its -redo run to the same MaxQuant experiment (1Leu: B8_6095 + C2_6104; 2Leu: B9_6096 + C3_6105; 3Leu: B10_6097 + C4_6106) and quantifies them together. MaxQuant "Fraction" values (1/2, and 2/1 for 2Leu) are not a fractionation scheme: the protocol describes single-shot 180-min runs, so these are re-acquisitions, encoded as technical replicates with comment[fraction identifier] 1. Original runs identified 1839-3306 MS/MS vs 15364-16373 for the redo runs (summary.txt), consistent with a failed first acquisition being repeated.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: the SILAC light channel of all 9 runs is NOT annotated. MaxQuant was run as 3-plex (light, Arg6/Lys4, Arg10/Lys8) and the light channel carries substantial signal (summed protein-group intensity L 2.6-4.4e9 vs M 1.6-2.5e9, H 1.5-2.6e9 per experiment; M/L log2 ratio profiles correlate r=0.28-0.57 across all six experiments, light/medium medians -0.41 to -0.77), but neither the paper, its S1 Fig ("cultured in medium and heavy SILAC media"; Fig 1 "a mixture of two lysates"), S1 Table (H/M ratios only), nor the PRIDE protocol says what the light-labelled sample is. Per campaign rule 7 no light rows with not-available conditions were written; BLOCKED.md section "PXD072695" lists the 9 runs.

Fig 2B legend says the Leu-arm medium cells received scrambled Ld-tRF-Asp; Fig 1 legend, the Methods oligo list (tRF-Leu-scrambled) and S1 Fig ("corresponding scrambled oligos") say scrambled Ld-tRF-Leu. The majority statement is annotated.

Leu original vs -redo runs: re-acquisition of the same pooled mixture is inferred from MaxQuant grouping them into one experiment and from the original runs having ~10x fewer identifications; the paper does not mention re-runs.
characteristics[infection] = uninfected rests on the absence of any infection step in the described SILAC workflow (transfection of synthetic oligos only), not on an explicit sentence.

Paper states MaxQuant 1.5.1.0 and fragment accuracy 0.05 Da; the deposited search outputs are MaxQuant 1.5.3.30 with TOF MS/MS tolerance 40 ppm and also include Deamidation (NQ). Deposited search values are annotated. Precursor tolerance 10 ppm is from the protocol text only (no mqpar.xml; MaxQuant_1.5.3.30.rar, 128 MB, not opened).
Instrument impact II from the paper/PRIDE protocol text only; the .d.1.dar raw archives (3-6 GB each) were not opened. Dissociation CID and TOF analyzer follow from the Q-TOF design.
Europe PMC REST returned HTTP 503 throughout; the full text was taken from the PLOS JATS XML. S2/S3 supplementary files (oligo/RNAhybrid tables) not needed for the proteomics design.
